answer: Sybil defense: a bonded lottery jury. Every grader locks 1,000 tokens, and each epoch a VRF draws 40 jurors to grade answers anonymously. Missing the window or splitting from the consensus slashes 200 tokens. Flipping one verdict needs 21 of 40 seats — 21,000 tokens bonded per epoch, 4,200 of it at immediate slash risk. Fresh bonds each epoch make farming fake identities too expensive to matter. Jurors reveal together after the deadline; no copying the majority. One whisper of dissent won't shift the verdict; the oasis of honest jurors holds the ridge against the swarm.
